name: cook-maid-booking
description: Cook & Home Maid Booking Platform — monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,admin,backend -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w admin" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w admin && npm run build -w backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w admin && npm run lint -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w admin && npm run typecheck -w backend
